articles.title_en: Physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust

articles.summary_zh: 实验物理学家、哈佛大学前科学系主任Christopher Stubbs博士加入了 Anthropic 的长期福利信托基金。他为我们带来了数十年来在观测宇宙学和精密测量方面的科学专业知识。他还就国家安全和军备控制问题向美国政府提供咨询。“我很荣幸加入 Anthropic 的长期福利信托，并帮助公司实现其公益使命，” Stubbs说。“我每天都在研究中使用人工智能工具，看看它们能带来什么，作为一名教育工作者，我遇到了他们提出的一些难题。作为一名祖父，我想帮助确保人工智能的开发和部署是为了人类的长期利益。“。斯塔布斯是塞缪尔·C。
articles.summary_en: Dr. Christopher Stubbs, an experimental physicist and former Dean of Science at Harvard University, has joined Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust. He brings to the Trust decades of scientific expertise across observational cosmology and precision measurement. He has also advised the US government on national security and arms control. “I am honored to join Anthropic’s Long-Term Benefit Trust and to help the company deliver on its public benefit mission,” said Stubbs. “I use AI tools in my research every day and see what they make possible, and as an educator I have confronted some of the hard questions they raise. As a grandfather, I want to help ensure that AI is developed and deployed for the long-term benefit of humanity.” Stubbs is the Samuel C.

articles.title_en: How Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins

articles.summary_zh: 我们要求一个内部研究 Claude 模型来设计针对蝎子神经毒素的微型结合物 (紧密附着在靶标上的小蛋白质)。总结: 作为我们研究 Claude 如何帮助加速药物发现的工作的一部分，我们要求一个内部研究模型来设计针对蝎子神经毒素的小结合物 (紧密附着在靶标上的小蛋白质)。Claude 借鉴了我们与金融投资研究公司Citrini research合作开发的prompt和四个后续项目。Adaptyv Bio和Twist Bioscience的团队通过实验测试了211设计的结合。其中17个符合我们的标准。我们将发布所有211设计及其数据作为该领域的资源。
articles.summary_en: We asked an internal research Claude model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins. Summary: As part of our work experimenting with how Claude can help accelerate drug discovery, we asked an internal research model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins. Claude worked from our prompt and four follow-ups, which we developed in collaboration with the financial investment research firm Citrini Research. Teams at Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience experimentally tested 211 designs for binding. Of these, 17 met our criteria. We’re releasing all 211 designs and their data as a resource for the field.

articles.title_en: Using Claude to reduce the attack surface of code

articles.summary_zh: 自动攻击面分析和减少可以在短期内有意义地提高已部署软件的安全性。在这篇文章中，我们预览了使用 Claude 将攻击面缩减技术应用于大型开源代码库所收集的数据。在过去的一年中，我们发布了大量数据，表明frontier AI模型能够发现和利用安全漏洞。然而，展示此前未知的漏洞可能被如何利用，仅仅只是前沿人工智能模型在网络安全防御领域所能发挥作用的开端。
articles.summary_en: Automated attack surface analysis and reduction can meaningfully improve the security of deployed software in the near term. In this post, we preview data we’ve collected from applying attack surface reduction techniques to large open-source codebases using Claude. Over the past year, we’ve published lots of data that shows that frontier AI models are more than capable of discovering and exploiting security vulnerabilities. Showing how previously unknown vulnerabilities might be exploited is, however, only the start of what frontier AI models can do for cyber defense.

articles.title_en: Reducing Reward Hacking by Localizing Bad Behavior Instead of Penalizing It
articles.title_zh: 通过将不良行为局部化而非直接惩罚，来减少奖励滥用
articles.summary_zh: 在训练过程中，模型有时会学会通过“作弊”来完成任务，而不是按照预期的方式解决问题，这种现象被称为奖励漏洞（reward hacking）。一种缓解措施是使用自动化监测系统来检测并惩罚攻击行为，但这可能会使模型学会以监测系统无法发现的方式进行攻击。我们提出了GRAFT方法，该方法将由检测到的攻击所引发的学习更新仅限于一组特定的参数，并在训练完成后将其移除。我们发现，移除这些参数可以有效防止奖励漏洞，包括那些连监控机制都无法检测到的漏洞。在我们的实验中，尽管仅限于小型模型和简单的监控机制，该方法能够在防止奖励漏洞的同时，仍能引导模型完成预期任务。
articles.summary_en: During training, models sometimes learn to cheat at tasks rather than solve them in the intended way, a problem known as reward hacking. One mitigation is to use an automated monitor to detect and penalize hacks, but this can teach the model to hack in ways the monitor can’t detect. We propose GRAFT, which instead confines the learning updates from detected hacks to a designated set of parameters that we remove after training. We find that removing these parameters can prevent reward hacks, including hacks that the monitors can’t detect. In our experiments, which are limited to small models and simple monitors, this method prevents reward hacks while still teaching the model to perform the intended task.

articles.title_en: The AI expectations gap
articles.title_zh: 人工智能期望差距
articles.summary_zh: 未来几年，AI将如何重塑经济？关于人工智能未来对经济的影响，分歧的核心来源是什么？本说明就这些问题提出了新的调查证据。Szymon Sacher，Tess Cotter，Charles I. Jones，Anton Korinek，Peter McCrory未来几年AI将如何重塑经济？人工智能能力正在迅速发展，未来的人工智能模型可能能够建立自己的继任者 (递归自我改进)，这可能会进一步加快进展速度。这可能实现的速度有多快，达到什么程度尚不清楚。预测差异很大，而且争论激烈。关于人工智能未来对经济的影响，分歧的核心来源是什么？
articles.summary_en: How will AI reshape the economy in the years ahead? What is the core source of disagreement about AI's future impact on the economy? This note presents new survey evidence on these questions. Szymon Sacher, Tess Cotter, Charles I. Jones, Anton Korinek, Peter McCrory How will AI reshape the economy in the years ahead? AI capabilities are advancing rapidly, and the possibility that future AI models may be able to build their own successors (recursive self-improvement) could further accelerate the rate of progress. How quickly this might materialize and to what extent is unclear. Forecasts vary widely and are fiercely debated. What is the core source of disagreement about AI's future impact on the economy?

articles.title_en: Designing more efficient quantum circuits with Claude
articles.title_zh: 用 Claude 设计更高效的量子电路
articles.summary_zh: Claude 设计的量子电路主要靠自己工作，在最好的出版版本上有所改进，在某些情况下改进了一个数量级或更多。量子计算机需要精心设计的量子线路，才能在有限的硬件上运行有用的算法。我们为八个这样的电路提供了 Claude 的简单语言规范，这些规范来自化学，优化，物理模拟和数论，以及一个自动评估器，可以检查和评分每个设计。Claude 在很大程度上依靠自己的工作，发现设计可以改善已发布的最佳电路，在某些情况下可以改善一个数量级或更多。这样的改进大大减少了有用应用程序所需的量子资源，因此实用的量子计算机可能比以前预期的更快到达。
articles.summary_en: Working largely on its own, Claude designed quantum circuits that improve on the best published versions, in some cases by an order of magnitude or more. Quantum computers will need carefully designed circuits to run useful algorithms on limited hardware. We gave Claude plain-language specifications for eight such circuits, drawn from chemistry, optimization, physics simulation, and number theory, along with an automated evaluator that checks and scores each design. Working largely on its own, Claude found designs that improve on the best published circuits, in some cases by an order of magnitude or more. Such improvements substantially reduce the quantum resources that useful applications require, so practical quantum computers could arrive sooner than previously anticipated.

articles.title_en: How employment is changing at Anthropic
articles.title_zh: Anthropic的就业状况正在发生怎样的变化
articles.summary_zh: 人工智能如何重塑了Anthropic的工作与就业？作为一家处于人工智能应用前沿的企业，Anthropic可能成为衡量人工智能如何在整个经济体中重塑工作组织、招聘模式及劳动力需求的先行指标。在人工智能日益强大的背景下，我们有望看到哪些工作与就业方面的变革？Anthropic 值得研究，因为它已将其工作流程全面融入人工智能。助理们穿梭于Slack聊天中，并安排会议。它们能够自主修复缺陷，并协同攻克大型工程项目。客服人员的工作时长是人工的6倍。当前在Anthropic发生的变革，正在为未来的工作与就业趋势发出重要信号。
articles.summary_en: How has AI restructured work and employment at Anthropic? As a company at the frontier of AI adoption, Anthropic could be a leading indicator of how AI will shift work organization, hiring, and labor demand across the economy. What transformations of work and employment can we expect under increasingly powerful AI? Anthropic is worth studying because it has thoroughly molded its workflows around AI. Agents flit through Slack chats and schedule meetings. They autonomously fix bugs and collectively tackle huge engineering projects. Agent hours worked outnumber human hours 6 to 1. Changes happening at Anthropic now give advanced signals about a possible future of work and employment.

articles.title_en: Working at the frontier shapes expectations for the future
articles.title_zh: 在前沿领域工作塑造了对未来的期望。
articles.summary_zh: 我们分享两份报告：第一份报告探讨了人工智能如何改变Anthropic内部的就业状况，第二份报告则分析了公众与Anthropic员工在人工智能对工作和经济影响方面的预期差异。Anthropic 员工和美国工人似乎对人工智能如何影响就业并没有不同的看法。相反，他们对人工智能能力的认知存在差异。这些不同的经历似乎与人们对未来工作形态的预期密切相关。Anthropic 是一家处于人工智能应用前沿的企业，而这种应用已经改变了我们的招聘方式。我们发现，过去一年中，我们在初级岗位上的招聘比例有所下降，同时从事技术类岗位的员工占比也有所减少。
articles.summary_en: We’re sharing two reports: the first covers how AI is changing employment inside Anthropic, and the second looks at the gap between how the public and Anthropic employees expect AI to affect work and the economy. Anthropic staff and US workers don’t seem to have different theories about how AI affects jobs. Instead, they have different experiences of what AI capabilities are. Those different experiences seem closely related to perceptions about what will happen to work in the future. Anthropic is a company at the frontier of AI adoption, and that adoption has changed the way we hire. We find that over the past year, we're hiring for a smaller share of junior positions, and a smaller share of our employees work in technical roles.

articles.title_en: Review your agents' sessions for security issues with Claude | Claude Cookbook

articles.summary_zh: 构建针对已完成客服会话的评价系统。它会将托管代理会话、消息API日志或代理SDK日志转化为文本记录，标记代码中异常之处，在托管代理的动态工作流中由Claude对每条会话进行审核，并返回一份附有引用证据的排序报告。代理程序无需人工干预即可运行。查看他们事后所采取的行动，可以揭示出您的网络边界、权限策略和凭据管理存在哪些未按预期设置得更为宽松的地方。本手册将构建一项审核功能，该功能会读取您的客服人员已完成的对话，并查找超出您所允许范围的操作；您将获得一份按优先级排序的对话列表，其中每条记录都附有相关证据。它会读取托管代理会话、消息API日志或Claude代理SDK日志。网络限制和权限策略阻止了相关操作。
articles.summary_en: Build a review system for finished agent sessions. It turns Managed Agents sessions, Messages API logs or Agent SDK logs into transcripts, flags what looks off in code, has Claude review each session in a Managed Agents dynamic workflow, and returns a ranked report with quoted evidence. Agents work unattended. Reading what they did afterwards shows where your network limits, permission policies and credentials are looser than you intended. This cookbook builds a review that reads your agents' finished sessions and looks for actions outside what you allowed: You get a ranked list of the sessions worth a person's attention, with quoted evidence for each. It reads Managed Agents sessions, Messages API logs, or Claude Agent SDK logs. Network limits and permission policies block actions.

articles.title_en: Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins

articles.title_en: Training Alignment Auditors via Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 通过强化学习培训合规审计员
articles.summary_zh: 我们使用强化学习培训了LLM名对齐审计员。在我们的训练环境中，策略会针对在其系统提示中植入了隐蔽行为的目标模型进行探测。在该环境中对Haiku 4.5进行微调后，其在用于审计质量的保留评估集上的表现与Opus 4.6相当，并且能够泛化到不同框架下的更难、经过微调的目标上。前沿模型开发者在部署前的评估中越来越多地依赖自动化审计系统（Anthropic，2025）。在这些系统中，一名LLM审核员会在多个场景下的多轮交互中对候选模型进行评估，以探查其是否存在值得关注或非预期的行为。
articles.summary_en: We train LLM alignment auditors with reinforcement learning. In our training environment, the policy investigates target models with hidden behaviors planted in their system prompt. After finetuning Haiku 4.5 on this environment, it matches Opus 4.6 on held-out evaluations for auditing quality and generalizes to harder, fine-tuned targets in a different scaffold. Frontier model developers increasingly rely on automated auditing systems as part of their pre-deployment evaluations ( Anthropic, 2025 ). In these systems, an LLM auditor investigates a candidate model in a multi-turn interaction across many scenarios, probing for concerning or unintended behaviors.

articles.title_en: Anthropic update on independent evaluators

articles.summary_zh: 上个月，我们承诺对我们的模型和安全实践进行更强有力的独立第三方评估。我们还签署了《白宫超人工智能协议》，其中各公司承诺与独立的外部审计机构或评估机构开展合作。今天，我们宣布，我们已经开始向员工提供类似METR团队的访问权限，METR是一家评估前沿人工智能模型的非营利组织。METR将公布其风险评估结果。在过去的一年中，我们与METR合作对我们的风险报告进行了多次审查。我们还与SecureBio和埃森哲合作作为评估人员，并正在与其他几个组织进行早期讨论，包括拥抱脸。
articles.summary_en: Last month, we committed to stronger independent, third-party assessment of our models and safety practices. We also signed the White House Accord on Super Intelligence, in which companies pledged to partner with independent external auditors or evaluators. Today, we’re announcing that we’ve started to give employee-like access to a team from METR , a nonprofit that evaluates frontier AI models. METR will publish the results of its risk assessments. Over the past year, we’ve worked with METR on several reviews of our Risk Reports . We’re also working with SecureBio and Accenture as evaluators, and are in early discussions with several other organizations, including Hugging Face .

articles.title_en: Code Review is now generally available
articles.title_zh: 代码评审现已全面可用。
articles.summary_zh: 在缺陷进入生产环境之前，尽早发现更多问题。代码评审功能现已面向 Claude 团队版和企业版组织全面开放。代码评审已退出研究预览阶段，现向Claude团队版和企业版组织开放。编码助手持续提升团队的代码编写速度，但代码评审的瓶颈仍未缓解。在正式发布版本中，我们提升了代码审查的速度，增强了其发现关键缺陷的能力，并使其更易于针对每个代码库进行个性化配置。自我们发布研究预览版以来，代码审查功能已更加完善，能够发现更多原本可能进入生产环境的缺陷。我们还在 Anthropic 对拉取请求执行代码评审，这让我们能够了解哪些评审环节拖慢了我们自身工程师的进度。
articles.summary_en: Catch more bugs before they reach production. Code Review is generally available for Claude Team and Enterprise organizations. Code Review is out of research preview and available to Claude Team and Enterprise organizations. Coding agents keep increasing the pace at which teams write code, and the review bottleneck hasn't eased. For general availability, we made Code Review faster, better at finding the bugs that matter, and easier to tune to each of your repositories. Since we released the research preview , Code Review has gotten sharper, catching more of the bugs that would otherwise reach production. We also run Code Review on pull requests at Anthropic, which shows us where reviews slow our own engineers down.

articles.title_en: How the Claude Code team does code review / claude.dev Blog
articles.title_zh: Claude代码团队如何进行代码评审/claude.dev博客
articles.summary_zh: 你们如何审查代理商所产出的大量代码？在Claude代码团队，一旦我们的测试覆盖率达到较高水平并实施了深度代码评审，我们便开始优化，力求将人工评审时间降至最低，同时确保不会引发回滚或事故。我们之前说过，Claude大约编写了Claude Code自身代码的90%。那么，我们如何在如此大规模的代码产出下进行代码评审呢？还有人看代码吗？那如果有什么东西坏了，谁来接住它呢？本文介绍了Claude代码团队的代码评审流程及其演进历程。从6月到9月，合并到Claude Code代码库的拉取请求数量增长了一倍以上，而不得不回滚的拉取请求占比则下降了40%以上。我们没有删除评论。
articles.summary_en: How do you review code at the volume agents produce it? On the Claude Code team, once we had high coverage and deep reviews, we started optimizing for the minimum amount of human review time that doesn't raise reverts or incidents. We've said before that Claude writes about 90 percent of Claude Code's own code. So how do we review code at the volume we produce it? Does anyone read code anymore? And if something breaks, who catches it? This post covers the code review flow on the Claude Code team and how it has evolved. From June to September, merged pull requests to Claude Code's codebase more than doubled while the share that had to be reverted fell by more than 40 percent. We didn't remove review.

articles.title_en: Trace Claude API requests and Managed Agents sessions with OpenTelemetry | Claude Cookbook

articles.summary_zh: 逐个属性地读取OpenTelemetry通过Python SDK为消息 API 请求、流、工具运行器循环以及托管代理会话所发出的跨度。然后将其导出到OTLP后端，并添加一个控制台输出目标，以便 API 的服务端跨度加入同一跟踪中。一个缓慢或昂贵的Claude请求无法告诉你时间和令牌都用在了哪里。OpenTelemetry（OTel）确实会生成跨度，这些跨度来自两个来源。Claude SDK会在您的进程中生成跨度，每发送一个请求就会生成一个。Claude API 会在 Anthropic 的端侧为每个请求内部的各项工作生成跟踪数据，并将其直接发送至您的可观测性后端。SDK会为每条请求添加一个traceparent头，而 API 则在其下挂载自己的跨度，因此这两者都会与您自己的处理器跨度和数据库跨度一起归入同一条调用链中。
articles.summary_en: Read the OpenTelemetry spans the Python SDK emits for Messages API requests, streams, tool-runner loops, and Managed Agents sessions, attribute by attribute. Then export to an OTLP backend and add a Console destination so the API's server-side spans join the same trace. A slow or expensive Claude request doesn't tell you where the time and tokens went. OpenTelemetry (OTel) spans do, and they come from two places. The Claude SDK emits spans inside your process, one per request it sends. The Claude API emits spans on Anthropic's side for the work inside each request, and delivers them straight to your observability backend. The SDK tags every request with a traceparent header and the API attaches its spans under it, so both land in one trace next to your own handler and database spans.

articles.title_en: Strengthening our defenses against distillation attacks
articles.title_zh: 加强我们对蒸馏攻击的防御能力
articles.summary_zh: 非法蒸馏允许模型开发人员复制frontier AI功能，而无需创建成比例的强大保护措施。在这里，我们描述了我们如何将蒸馏速率降低90% % 以上。最近几个月，我们在使用新方法降低 Claude 蒸馏攻击的有效性方面取得了实质性进展，正如我们在本博客中概述的那样。早期证据表明，这些方法已将蒸馏器收集的数据量减少了约90至99%。蒸馏攻击是秘密的，工业规模的活动，在没有原始模型开发人员授权的情况下，提取一个模型的功能并将其复制到另一个模型中。他们经常使用欺诈账户网络进行。
articles.summary_en: Illicit distillation allows model developers to copy frontier AI capabilities without creating proportionally robust safeguards. Here, we describe how we’ve reduced the rate of distillation by more than 90%. In recent months, we’ve made substantial progress on reducing the effectiveness of distillation attacks on Claude using new methods, as we outline in this blog. Early evidence suggests that these methods have reduced the amount of data harvested by distillers by around 90 to 99%. Distillation attacks are covert, industrial-scale campaigns to extract the capabilities of one model and replicate them in another, without the authorization of the original model’s developers. They are often conducted using networks of fraudulent accounts.

articles.title_en: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
articles.title_zh: AI模型可能能够在不访问数据中心的情况下进行自我复制
articles.summary_zh: 小型人工智能模型可能只有几个月的时间才能在Android电视盒等廉价物联网设备上进行自我复制，而不需要数据中心。我们的实验表明，小型人工智能模型可能需要几个月的时间才能在商业物联网 (IoT) 设备上进行自我复制，如智能烤箱和非品牌Android电视盒。像这样的复制器将是具有挑战性的关闭，因为没有集中点关闭-尽管它可能很慢 (数天的倍增时间)。与非人工智能恶意软件不同，它还可以自己找出不熟悉的设备。在我们的评估中，一个90亿参数的模型能够在我们测试的9种硬件类型中的8种上进行推理。
articles.summary_en: Small AI models may be only months away from being able to self-replicate across cheap IoT devices like Android TV boxes, with no datacenter needed. Our experiments suggest that small AI models may be months away from being capable enough to self-replicate on commercial internet-of-things (IoT) devices, like smart ovens and off-brand Android TV boxes. A replicator like this would be challenging to shut down, since there’s no centralized point to shut off—though it may be slow (with a doubling time of days). Unlike non-AI malware, it could also figure out unfamiliar devices on its own. In our evaluations, a 9B model got inference running on 8 of the 9 hardware types we tested.

articles.title_en: Investigating unintended model actions in our evaluations and internal use

articles.summary_zh: 在这里，约翰霍普金斯大学的天体物理学家，Anthropic 的研究员bricemnard解释了他如何与 Claude Science合作制作第一张完整的紫外线天空图。该地图将是一个有价值的教育工具，让学生详细了解在这个波长下可见的银河系的丰富结构。整个天空，银河系中心在中间，紫外线 (结合远紫外线154 nm和近紫外线232 nm)。这张地图的大约三分之一，包括银河系平面的大部分，是由 Claude Science使用本文概述的方法预测的。地图的其他图层将每个像素标记为 “测量” 或 “预测”，并提供不确定性估计; 你可以在这里看到它。

articles.title_en: Building effective agent automations / claude.dev Blog

articles.summary_zh: 随着人工智能加速我们的工作，跟上节奏变得愈发困难。在Anthropic，简单的自动化代理经常被用来提供帮助。它们通常按预定时间运行，在后台收集上下文信息，并主动告知我们需要了解的内容。但构建有效的代理自动化并不容易：它们可能会在无人察觉的情况下失去对某个数据源的访问权限，或者无法遵循我们的偏好设置。借助 Claude 托管代理（测试版），我们构建了一个参考实现，该实现可按计划读取自定义数据源（例如Slack和GitHub代码库），跟踪自上次运行以来发生的变化，并将您需要了解的信息发布出去（例如推送到Slack）。在本文中，我们将逐步介绍每个步骤，分享一个参考实现，并提供一条可在 Claude Code中运行的命令，以帮您配置代理。
articles.summary_en: As AI accelerates our work, it's getting harder to keep up. At Anthropic, simple agent automations are frequently used to help. They often run on a schedule, gather context in the background, and proactively tell us what we need to know. But itâs difficult to build effective agent automations: they can lose access to a source without anyone noticing or fail to follow our preferences. Using Claude Managed Agents (beta), we built a reference implementation that reads custom sources (e.g., Slack and GitHub repos) on a schedule, tracks what changed since the last run, and posts what you need to know (e.g., to Slack). In this article, we walk through each step, share a reference implementation, and provide a command to run in Claude Code that configures the agent for you.

articles.summary_en: Matthew Schwartz describes what happened when he stopped fighting Claude and allowed Claude to find “Claude-shaped” problems. Summary: In this guest post, Prof. Matthew Schwartz returns to describe a new approach to AI-accelerated science. In Vibe Physics , Schwartz discussed similarities in capability between Claude and a physics graduate student. Here, he describes what happened when he stopped fighting Claude and allowed Claude to find “Claude-shaped” problems: ones best suited to the capabilities of the current generation of LLM tools. This led him to build BootLoops, a toolkit for exact calculations in quantitative science.

articles.title_en: Can we predict the jobs robots will do?
articles.title_zh: 我们能预测机器人会做什么工作吗？
articles.summary_zh: 机器人能做什么工作？Anthropic 的机器人暴露指数发现，机器人可以完成我们3/4的体力劳动任务，但仅在0.3% 方面具有成本竞争力。大型语言模型的进步提高了自动化大量工作的可能性。但许多工作是体力劳动。人工智能对经济的影响将部分取决于机器人技术。¹ 预测机器人进步的速度是困难的，但我们认为，列举今天的能力可以为未来几年提供洞察力。我们使用 Claude 来评估当今机器人执行工作任务的能力。当机器人能够在更不稳定的环境中完成更多工作任务时，该岗位的自动化风险就会更高。当机器人完成同一项任务的成本低于人工时，它就具备了成本竞争力。
articles.summary_en: What work can robots do? Anthropic's robot exposure index finds robots can do 3/4 of US physical job tasks, but are cost-competitive for only 0.3%. Advances in large language models have raised the possibility of automating large swaths of work. But many jobs are physical. AI’s impact on the economy will in part depend on robotics.¹ Predicting the pace of robot advances is difficult, but enumerating capabilities today, we argue, can give insight into the coming years. We develop a measure of job exposure to robots, using Claude to assess how well present-day robots can perform work tasks. A job is more exposed when robots can do more of its tasks in less controlled environments. A robot is cost-competitive when it can do the same task for cheaper than a human worker.

articles.summary_zh: 在这篇客座文章中，物理学家兼科学作家马特·冯·希佩尔 (Matt von Hippel) 分享了他向人工智能公司发出关于他以前的理论物理学子领域的问题的挑战时所发生的事情。你发出挑战的情况并不常见，只是在一个月后看到它被击败。但是我们生活在不寻常的时代。让我自我介绍一下: 我是马特·冯·希佩尔。我曾经是一名理论物理学家; 现在我是一名科学作家。自始至终，我一直是一名博主，每周写一篇关于物理学和做物理学的人的t 4gravitons.com。越来越多的关于物理的博客意味着关于AI的博客。这是一个问题，因为我绝对不是AI专家。当然，我已经涉足了。我可能比你奶奶知道的更多。但我大多不得不退后一步，相信专家。
articles.summary_en: In this guest post, physicist and science writer Matt von Hippel shares what happened when he issued a challenge to AI companies regarding a problem in his former subfield of theoretical physics. It’s not often that you issue a challenge, only to see it beaten a month later. But we’re living in unusual times. Let me introduce myself: I’m Matt von Hippel. I used to be a theoretical physicist; these days I’m a science writer. Throughout, I’ve been a blogger, writing weekly at 4gravitons.com about physics and the people who do it. More and more, blogging about physics has meant blogging about AI. That’s a problem, because I’m definitely not an AI expert. I’ve dabbled in it, sure. I probably know more than your grandma. But I mostly have to step back and trust the experts.

articles.summary_en: The same token price can cost very different amounts per task. Learn what Claude Code tasks cost on Opus 5.5 and which settings change the bill. You don't set out to buy millions of tokens. You set out to build a feature, finish a migration, or run a task. The token count is whatever the model needed to get there. Two models with the same cost per token can cost very different amounts on the same task. One reads the code once. The other reads it, tries a fix, and reads it again. Each of those steps is a turn, and each turn resends the conversation so far. So the model that needs more turns costs more, even at the same price.

articles.title_en: Project Swap: What happens when agents trade for us?
articles.title_zh: 项目交换: 当代理商为我们进行交易时会发生什么？
articles.summary_zh: 为了了解当代理商被派往市场时什么有效以及什么中断，我们制作了一个 Claudes的微型市场。生活中充满了交易和交易，这会让每个人都过得更好，但永远不会发生。这通常仅仅是因为找到合适的交易对手并进行谈判直到达成交易需要花费太多的工作。想想那些在他们负担不起的报价后跳过治疗的病人，当有一家不同的诊所收费低得多的时候，或者如果被问到，引用他们的医院会削减账单。或者想想你的工作。在某个地方，可能会有一个更适合你的，雇主会很乐意雇用你。但是你们可能找不到彼此，因为你们都没有时间不断地寻找。
articles.summary_en: To see what works and what breaks when agents are sent into a market, we made a miniature market of Claudes. Life is full of deals and trades that would leave everyone better off, yet never happen. This is often simply because it takes too much work to find the right counterparty and negotiate until a deal is struck. Think of the patient who skips a treatment after one quote they can’t afford, when there’s a different clinic that charges far less, or the hospital that quoted them would have cut its bill if asked. Or think about your job. Somewhere there might be one that would suit you better, with an employer who would be glad to hire you. But you may not find each other, because neither of you has the time to be searching constantly.

We estimate Claude Opus 5.5 costs about 40% less to run than Opus 5 for typical workloads billed by token. For developers, exactly how those savings stack up matters. If you pay by the token, you will see the greatest cost difference for longer-running, higher context sessions–the exact type of Claude Code sessions that have become more prevalent in the last six months. Our focus is on fundamental biology research using Claude: exploring datasets of DNA to identify uncharacterized protein families, generating hypotheses at scale, and testing them through experiments in the lab. This post introduces the team behind this work and shares early results in which Claude discovered a novel enzyme system with properties reminiscent of CRISPR, with only high-level direction from our scientists.

articles.summary_zh: 代理可以在几个月内完成代码现代化，但变更管理仍然决定了步伐。定义目标、证书和促销政策的六个步骤。在我们的现场系列笔记中，Anthropic 前向部署的工程师分享了受实际客户部署启发的最佳实践。在本文中，我们分享了管理大型代码现代化项目的经验。代码现代化曾经是多年的，现在全员努力可以在几个月 (或几周) 内完成，但双方的组织工作通常保持不变。例如，对关键银行系统的每项变更都必须经过变更管理、审查和批准。这是一个强有力的过程，因为监管机构、审计师和企业都需要它。
articles.summary_en: Agents can finish code modernizations in months, but change management still sets the pace. Six steps to define the target, certificate, and promotion policy. In our Notes from the Field series, Anthropic forward deployed engineers share best practices inspired by real customer deployments. In this article, we share our experience managing large code modernization projects. Code modernizations once scoped as multi-year, all-hands efforts can now finish in months (or weeks ), but the organizational work on either side often remains the same. For example, every change to a critical banking system must go through change management, review, and approval. It is a robust process because regulators, auditors, and the business require it.
